description: This file defines a RateLimiterManager class for managing rate limiting using Redis and BullMQ, including dynamic updates and initialization based on chat flow configurations.

classes.name: RateLimiterManager
classes.description: Manages rate limiters with Redis backend, supports dynamic updates, initialization, and event-driven updates based on chat flow configurations.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns Redis connection options based on environment variables.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to get the single instance of RateLimiterManager.

methods.name: addRateLimiter
methods.description: Adds a new rate limiter for a given ID with specified duration, limit, and message.

methods.name: removeRateLimiter
methods.description: Removes the rate limiter associated with a given ID.

methods.name: getRateLimiter
methods.description: Returns middleware function to apply rate limiting based on request parameters.

methods.name: getRateLimiterById
methods.description: Returns middleware function to apply rate limiting for a specific ID.

methods.name: updateRateLimiter
methods.description: Updates or removes rate limiters based on chat flow configuration and environment mode.

methods.name: initializeRateLimiters
methods.description: Initializes rate limiters for a list of chat flows and sets up event listeners for dynamic updates.
